parsed.summary: After mapping the permuted reference designators, the netlist and SPICE deck match the intended architecture: external 5V diode, servo-rail diode and bulk caps, battery P-FET switch, MAX3485 serial bus with auto direction control, PWM series/selection jumpers, and pass-through M5Stack/PortB connectors are all present with the specified values and connectivity. Apparent swaps such as D1/D2 or Q1/Q3 are reference-label differences rather than behavior-changing deviations.
